# Particles in context

The new words carry furigana: <ruby>漢字<rt>かんじ</rt></ruby> and <ruby>助詞<rp>(</rp><rt>じょし</rt><rp>)</rp></ruby>.

<span class="gloss" lang="ja" title="topic marker">は</span> marks the topic, and <strong>が</strong> marks the subject.

<details open><summary>Grammar spotlight</summary>
A Japanese sentence ends with its verb.
</details>

```text
私は学生です。
```

Inline code such as `x = 1` is not a query, and $x^2$ is plain math.

See [[Particles primer]], ![[particle-chart.png]] and [the dictionary](https://example.org/dictionary).
